project.name: Impilo — Emergency Domain (WHO Interagency Integrated Triage Tool)
project.description:
Pure Java 21 emergency primitives shared by the clinical plane: the WHO/ICRC/MSF Interagency Integrated Triage Tool for age 12-and-over and age under-12, in three-valued logic so an unassessed patient is never scored as a well one.
Transcribed from the vendored, hashed charts in docs/reference/who-emergency-care-toolkit/ and verified against the pdftotext extractions committed beside them. Those charts carry no version number, so the SHA-256 recorded there is the version identity.
No Spring, no I/O, so the same engine runs inside a service, a batch job or an offline package. It owns the published criteria, never national policy: time targets, zone maps and destination rules are content, because the IITT FAQ is explicit that time-to-care per colour is for facilities to determine.
